rules.input_representation: goal_state is the list of top-level goal clauses returned by the pinned BDDL parse_problem packaging; the list is an implicit top-level conjunction
rules.atomic_occurrence_count: count every atomic predicate occurrence before deduplication
rules.atomic_goal_count: count unique signed atomic leaves after scope-aware alpha-renaming; exact duplicate signed leaves collapse
rules.logical_depth: atomic leaf depth=1; explicit and/or/not/imply/forall/exists/forn/forpairs/fornpairs each add 1; implicit top-level conjunction adds 0
rules.coupling_nodes: the unique signed atomic leaves used for atomic_goal_count
rules.coupling_edge: undirected binary edge between two atomic nodes iff they share at least one literal grounded argument or the same scope-aware alpha-renamed bound variable; predicate names and binder category names do not create edges
rules.negation: negation changes signed leaf identity and logical depth but not its argument symbols for coupling
rules.quantifier: do not expand to domain instances; alpha-rename bound variables by lexical quantifier scope; the same raw variable token in disjoint scopes is not shared
rules.branching: primary graph is a conservative full-AST graph across all leaves, including alternatives under or/imply; branch_operator_count is reported separately
rules.largest_connected_component: size in atomic nodes; 0 for no atoms
